additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this grid image.

capturedWith._instruction: Add the device used to capture this grid image.

coordinateFramework._instruction: Add the coordinate space in which this grid image exists.

dataLocation._instruction: Add a reference to the file to which this grid image information applies. If the information applies uniformly to a grid image file series, a reference to the corresponding file bundle may be provided instead.

dimension._instruction: Enter the dimension of this grid image in pixels.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name of this grid image preferably matching the filename.

pixelSize._instruction: Enter the physical pixel size for this grid image (in x,y order).
